profile.ends: Zero derivative at both endpoints; flat extension at endpoint Y outside the ramp domain.
profile.supportDomain: Unique support across the union of four-column covered hexes; inner two columns are stoppable, outer two are non-stoppable ramp_shoulder with blocksGroundMove=true and blocksLineOfSight=false. Clip original Tile tops/walls inside this footprint. Only listed lower/upper shared-edge portals are open.
profile.shoulderPresentation: D3 must visibly present the shoulder as non-traversable edge earthwork or gravel, not indistinguishable empty flat ground. The body swept-clearance region remains the same smooth support profile: no railing or protruding stones inside it. Decorations may occupy only the outer shoulder region after finite geometry establishes clearance.
profile.logicalHeightQuantization: lowerLevel below the worldZ midpoint; upperLevel above it; no half-level state. heightLevel alone remains rule input.
profile.turning: Use enumerated full pair poses/turns and finite profile shoulders plus horizontal platforms; no untested full-circle turning claim.
profile.geometryStatus: D1 fixed design accepted: all 390 legal stationary pair poses and two dynamic witness routes (1295 samples,1240 conservatively bounded intervals). This is not geometry validation of all 993 graph-legal dynamic transitions; see shared geometry evidence and D3 runtime obligations.

localCoordinates: x = worldX - .5; y = worldY - lowerY; z = worldZ - worldZStart
